## Laboratory Scope & Operational Role
- Role: Synthetic evidence generation, adversarial edge testing, and non-deterministic candidate production.
- Untrusted Ingress Boundary: All outputs, tokens, and payloads emitted from this lab possess zero direct execution privileges.
- Downstream Routing: Proposals are serialized into canonical CFSR/UEDO envelopes and submitted to downstream verification membranes (arcstone-continuity-core and arcstone-triad-system) via unprivileged raw topics (*_raw).
- Static Payload Constraints: Generated candidates must conform to the S_max <= 4096B memory envelope and tau_override <= 11.99ms evaluation deadline.
